tested_source_note: Runs used the base checkout with the added benchmark/edge tools and documentation, before those changes were committed. The current source fingerprint matches the latest regression result. Benchmark/edge raw reports do not embed source fingerprints; their scripts are recorded below.
excluded: Live workspace databases, locks, virtualenv, caches and duplicate exploratory runs. The complete generated mock corpus is in edge_cases/mock-data.zip.
original_paths: Absolute /workspace paths in raw logs/receipts are original run locations and have been preserved. They are not portable replay instructions.
known_defect: Three events --after values outside SQLite signed int64 produce one unfixed OverflowError defect. Edge runner exits 1 for these failures.
cloud_publication: This evidence package does not publish environment settings or a software release.
